title: Noctune Agent State
description: Cross-session state persisted by the runner. Read at BOOT, written at each phase transition.

phase.description: Current session phase. 'idle' means no task is running.

current_id.description: ID of the task currently being executed, or null if idle.

plan.description: 5-line plan written during PLAN phase. Null if not yet planned.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task started. Used for timeout detection.

retry_count.description: Number of gate retry attempts consumed for the current task.
